title: url_to_path in cmd_restore strips all leading slashes converting absolute path to relative
description: main.rs cmd_restore inner fn url_to_path: after stripping sqlite:// prefix it calls trim_start_matches('/') which removes ALL leading slashes. sqlite:////data/transit.db becomes data/transit.db (relative). Correct: strip exactly the sqlite:// prefix and then keep one slash for the absolute path. sqlite:///data/transit.db should yield /data/transit.db.
